content: In case the Dem_J1939DcmSetRatioFilter, Dem_J1939DcmSetDTCFilter or Dem_J1939DcmSetFreezeFrameFilter returns Specification of a Diagnostic Communication Manager for SAE J1939 AUTOSAR CP R19 - 11 25 of 97 Document ID 610 : AUTOSAR_SWS_SAEJ1939DiagnosticCommunicationManager - AUTOSAR confidential - E_OK and the ‘ FreezeFrameKind ’ is set to ’ DE M_J1939DCM_SPNS_IN_EXPANDED_FREEZEFRAME ’, t he J1939 Diagnostic Communication Manager shall continue the sequence by subsequent calling the Dem_J1939DcmGetNextSPNInFreezeFrame, till the return ed value is ‘ DEM_NO_SUCH_ELEMENT ’. The calls may spread over several calls of J1939Dcm_MainFunction.

The calls may spread over several calls of J1939Dcm_MainFunction.
